decision: Already adapted in owned legacy source: queued hover captures parent owner and generation and opens only while that same owner remains current and open with unchanged generation. Parent closing invalidates the generation and open state, so hover while exiting and stale hover across close/reopen are rejected. This source conclusion does not claim current artifact execution or equivalence of all reentrant state machines.
current_source_reasoning: Owned parent owner is in MENU_PANEL_OWNERS; queued hover snapshots owner and generation, then rejects unless owner remains current, menuOpen and same generation. Root close increments generation and clears menuOpen before delayed child open. This prevents stale child hover both during exit and after parent close/reopen, without relying on modern peer or private modern state.
historical_reasoning: Tagged delayed hovered path does not gate parent exiting and could open after the closing parent has begun exit.
peer_reasoning: 22.1.7 modern _handleHover tests _panelAnimationState !== void. Implementations differ; no claim all reentrant state machines are equivalent.
test_names: MatMenu > ignores hover while the parent is exiting
MatMenu > opens a submenu on hover while the parent is open
